name: zeesha-collection
description: Zeesha Collection — premium abayas and burkhas storefront (React SPA + Express API + MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n db,server,client -c yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev:db -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
